name: Guyana
gaps: No national ornithological society found with BirdLife partnership. Most administrative regions have no dedicated bird clubs or observation programs.

groups.name: Guyana Amazon Tropical Birds Society
groups.blurb: Independent society working with vulnerable youth on ornithological research, education, and bird identification training.

groups.name: South Rupununi Conservation Society
groups.blurb: Conservation organization protecting red siskins and monitoring tropical birds in Guyana's Rupununi savannah region.

name: Suriname
gaps: No national BirdLife partner or dedicated ornithological society with public membership. Most districts lack organized birding groups.

Suriname Conservation Foundation was left out: it is a government hosted conservation trust fund rather than a community with membership or volunteer birding. Green Heritage Fund is a general wildlife NGO rather than a bird club, kept because it runs the public nature education Suriname birders take part in.

groups.name: Green Heritage Fund Suriname
groups.blurb: Nonprofit promoting sustainable use of natural resources and running wildlife conservation and education programs.

groups.name: Suriname Birds
groups.blurb: Public Facebook group for sharing bird sightings, identification help, and birding experiences in Suriname.

name: French Guiana
gaps: Limited formal bird club structure outside of Cayenne area. Faune Guyane ornithological observation platform exists but URL could not be verified (SSL certificate issue).
GEPOG has an active Facebook page as well, left out here because its own site is already listed and one organisation earns one card.

groups.name: GEPOG
groups.blurb: Bird study and protection group managing reserves and conducting ornithological research across French Guiana.

groups.name: Association KWATA
groups.blurb: Founded 1994, focused on study and conservation of fauna and natural habitats in French Guiana's rainforests.

groups.name: Falklands Conservation
groups.blurb: National conservation organization and BirdLife partner managing nature reserves and seabird monitoring programmes.

groups.name: Falkland Islands Seabird Monitoring Programme
groups.blurb: Citizen science program monitoring penguin, albatross and petrel populations since 1989, visiting colonies regularly.

groups.name: The Watch Group
groups.blurb: Junior citizen science program for ages 8 to 16 with field trips to wildlife sites and conservation badge awards.
